Alex Kim: Heads up — marketplace security is asking for the SOC2 summary, the most recent external pen-test report, ASV scan output, and our completed vendor questionnaire by EOD Friday. Can we assemble these? cc @Maria Garcia @Darren Choi
Maria Garcia: We can share a redacted SOC2 Type II PDF + the trust center link. Legal wants any customer-identifying info removed. Pen-test is trickier: last external was 2024-11 (SecureWave) before the new VPC overlay.
Darren Choi: I'll check infra for ASV logs for the marketplace VPC. If there's no ASV run on the new subnet, we should note that and provide timeline for a scan.
Jenna H: I can handle redaction. Where should I upload the artifacts once ready? Also, there's a vendor questionnaire (docx) with ~120 Qs — who owns answers for infra/network/security/app?
Samir Patel: Security should own final answers, but we can draft. I'll take infra/network. @Maria — can you do application-level questions?
Maria Garcia: Yep, I'll start the app answers. For the questionnaire, suggest we use the CSV template the marketplace gave: `marketplace-qna-template.csv`. I'll fill app sections.
Marketplace Bot: New intake created: MKP-882. Deadline set to 2025-03-28 17:00 UTC. Attachments allowed via secure upload link.
Alex Kim: Jenna — please upload to `s3://redwood/marketplace/compliance/1780501234/` (internal path) and ping the security reviewers. Use `kms:prod` for object encryption.
Jenna H: Got it. I'll upload SOC2-redacted.pdf and initial questionnaire draft as `questions-draft.csv`. Also will add a short readme with redaction notes.
Darren Choi: Update on ASV: infra says we only have an internal Nessus scan from Jan 2025; ASV vendor hasn't been engaged for the marketplace subnet. I'll open a ticket to schedule an ASV scan — ETA Wed next week.
Samir Patel: I'll try to rebook SecureWave for an external pen-test early next week. If that slips, we'll include a mitigation note and offer to run an internal gap scan to hold the line.
Alex Kim: Plan sounds good. Primary ask: deliver redacted SOC + questionnaire draft by EOD Friday so partner can start review. Pen-test/ASV can be follow-ups but must have clear ETA.
Maria Garcia: I'll have app answers ready by Thursday morning for review.
Jenna H: Uploading now — will post link when done.
Alex Kim: Thanks team — please update thread when uploads/tickets are in. :thumbsup:
Marketplace Bot: Reminder: MKP-882 requires signed NDA for any raw reports. Ensure an NDA is attached before sending unredacted artifacts.
Samir Patel: Noted. We'll only share redacted artifacts until NDA is signed.
